diagnosis.what_happened: Partitioned unidimensional scales into ad-hoc item parcels instead of using mandated composite total scores.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Ad-hoc parceling of unidimensional scales introduces arbitrary measurement error and violates the mandate for composite total scores.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Specify unidimensional constructs as single-indicator latent variables with factor loading fixed to 1.0 and measurement error variance fixed to Var(y)*(1-alpha).
diagnosis.rationale_why: Aligns with PRN-20260923-3A3A2B for SEM latent specification, while remaining synchronized with LSN-2026-ATOMIC-MICRO-STAGE-TRIAD-SYNTHESIS.

desired_behavior: When composite total scores are mandated for unidimensional constructs (e.g., SCI_T, PA_Negative, BSSI_T), specify them in R lavaan as single-indicator latent variables with factor loading fixed to 1.0 and measurement error variance fixed to Var(y) * (1 - alpha). Synchronize output generation with LSN-2026-ATOMIC-MICRO-STAGE-TRIAD-SYNTHESIS.
generalization: Latent variables with a single observed indicator must be specified by fixing the factor loading to 1.0 and error variance to Var(y)*(1 - alpha) instead of arbitrary ad-hoc parceling.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero tolerance for ad-hoc parceling in unidimensional scales
